primary_endpoint: Percentage change from baseline in MRI-PDFF at Week 12.
efficacy_outcome: MRI-PDFF change was -9.76% (10 mg), -14.24% (20 mg), and -13.00% (50 mg), versus -20.78% with placebo; p=0.0874, 0.3151, and 0.2313, respectively.
safety_signal: Serious AEs occurred in 1/53 (10 mg), 3/51 (20 mg), and 5/50 (50 mg) seladelpar recipients versus 0/27 with placebo; no deaths were reported.
